July 4, 2018 - By Louis Casey
Investors sentiment decreased to 0.68 in Q1 2018. Its down 0.15, from 0.83 in 2017Q4. It worsened, as 83 investors sold AET shares while 335 reduced holdings. 78 funds opened positions while 208 raised stakes. 269.52 million shares or 2.24% less from 275.71 million shares in 2017Q4 were reported. Neuberger Berman Grp Ltd holds 2.23M shares or 0.43% of its portfolio. Park Natl Oh has 0.01% invested in Aetna Inc. (NYSE:AET). Wetherby Asset Mngmt has invested 0.18% in Aetna Inc. (NYSE:AET). Central National Bank stated it has 0.45% in Aetna Inc. (NYSE:AET). 18,370 were reported by Meeder Asset Management Inc. Coastline Trust owns 2,105 shares or 0.05% of their US portfolio. The Pennsylvania-based Fulton Financial Bank Na has invested 0.22% in Aetna Inc. (NYSE:AET). Kames Cap Public Ltd stated it has 1.11% of its portfolio in Aetna Inc. (NYSE:AET). British Columbia Invest Management stated it has 0.19% in Aetna Inc. (NYSE:AET). Arizona State Retirement, a Arizona-based fund reported 146,784 shares. Putnam Fl Management invested 1.14% in Aetna Inc. (NYSE:AET). Guardian Life Com Of America reported 0.02% of its portfolio in Aetna Inc. (NYSE:AET). Prudential Public Limited Liability Corporation holds 0% of its portfolio in Aetna Inc. (NYSE:AET) for 2,032 shares. Hudson Bay Cap Management LP holds 713,959 shares. First Manhattan accumulated 4,160 shares.
Sander Gerber decreased its stake in Aetna Inc New (AET) by 15.59% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Hudson Bay Capital Management Lp sold 131,851 shares as the company’s stock rose 1.59% while stock markets declined. The hedge fund run by Sander Gerber held 713,959 shares of the medical specialities company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $120.66 million, down from 845,810 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Hudson Bay Capital Management Lp who had been investing in Aetna Inc New for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $60.58 billion market cap company. The stock decreased 0.26% or $0.48 during the last trading session, reaching $185.2. About 666,839 shares traded. Aetna Inc. (NYSE:AET) has risen 22.94% since July 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 10.37% the S&P500.
Hudson Bay Capital Management Lp, which manages about $4.18 billion and $4.82B US Long portfolio, upped its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 74,800 shares to 86,550 shares, valued at $14.52M in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also increased its holding in Voya Financial Inc (NYSE:VOYA) by 187,657 shares in the quarter, for a total of 212,201 shares, and has risen its stake in General Motors Co (NYSE:GM).
Analysts await Aetna Inc. (NYSE:AET) to report earnings on August, 2. They expect $3.12 EPS, down 8.77 % or $0.30 from last year’s $3.42 per share. AET’s profit will be $1.02 billion for 14.84 P/E if the $3.12 EPS becomes a reality. After $3.19 actual EPS reported by Aetna Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -2.19 % negative EPS growth.
